text.ja: NUMERICAL METHODS ATLAS · PROBLEM Dirichlet境界でのStrang次数低下と補正 この問題の式、参照の条件、計算法、公開済みのコードをたどります。 保存済みの結果図 実1D非周期場で、未補正/境界補正Strangを同じFD参照へ比較し、時間誤差と空間誤差を分けます。 保存済みの数値場と参照を用いた図です。 方程式・問題の定義 u_t=u_xx+u、[0,1]、両端u=1、解析定常解+.1正弦摂動、T=.1。内部31/63/127点・8/16/32/64刻みとLie対照4run、計28run。 非同次境界を持つ線形反応拡散 ut=uxx+u,0<x<1,u(0,t)=u(1,t)=1 同じ非周期有限差分系に対する時間誤差と、連続厳密解に対する空間誤差を分けます。 熱・拡散方程式 ∂tu=ν∇2u 一定拡散係数νの代表形。モードの減衰、時間積分、境界条件へ。 実行例で使う式 補助実行例実行例の定義・検証式 Dirichlet境界でのStrang次数低下と補正 ut=uxx+u,u(0,t)=u(1,t)=1,w=u−1 Araw(w)=Lhw, Braw(w)=w+1;Acorr(w)=Lhw+1, Bcorr(w)=w 実1D非周期場で、未補正/境界補正Strangを同じFD参照へ比較し、時間誤差と空間誤差を分けます。 厳密解・参照解 独立疎affine指数作用と別記述の正弦和を先に資格。同FD時間誤差・解析連続解との差・固定格子/刻み領域の観測次数を判定。 半解析解同じ問題の参照 Dirichlet境界でのStrang次数低下と補正 u_t=u_{xx}+u,\quad u(0,t)=u(1,t)=1,\quad w=u-1;\quad A_{\rm raw}(w)=L_hw,\ B_{\rm raw}(w)=w+1;\quad A_{\rm corr}(w)=L_hw+1,\ B_{\rm corr}(w)=w u_t=u_xx+u、[0,1]、両端u=1、解析定常解+.1正弦摂動、T=.1。内部31/63/127点・8/16/32/64刻みとLie対照4run、計28run。 原著の線形特殊例で非線形数値表の再現ではありません。非自律/一般境界や普遍的な次数低下は主張せず、Lie終端の反応trace不整合も別表示します。 実行例の参照と結果 補助実行例 Dirichlet境界でのStrang次数低下と補正 独立疎affine指数作用と別記述の正弦和を先に資格。同FD時間誤差・解析連続解との差・固定格子/刻み領域の観測次数を判定。 保存結果 / JSON 参照・検証条件の詳細 → 計算法 w=u−1で未補正(Lw,w+1)、補正(Lw+1,w)に分割。実DirichletDST-I指数流を合成し、反応の境界不整合を保持します。 text.en: NUMERICAL METHODS ATLAS · PROBLEM Strang splitting: Dirichlet boundary order reduction and correction Explore this problem’s equations, reference conditions, methods and published code. Saved result figure Evolve actual one-dimensional nonperiodic fields and compare unmodified and boundary-corrected Strang splitting against the same spatial discretization. This preview reads saved numerical fields and references only. Equations and problem definitions Solve u_t = u_xx + u on [0, 1] with both boundary values equal to 1, an analytic steady state plus a 0.1 sine perturbation, and T = 0.1. Use 31, 63 and 127 interior nodes with 8, 16, 32 and 64 steps, plus four Lie controls: 28 runs. Linear reaction-diffusion with inhomogeneous boundaries ut=uxx+u,0<x<1,u(0,t)=u(1,t)=1 Separate temporal errors relative to the same nonperiodic finite-difference system from spatial errors relative to the continuous exact family. Heat / diffusion equation ∂tu=ν∇2u A representative constant-diffusivity form: mode decay, time integration and boundaries. Formulations used by execution examples Supplementary execution exampleExample definition or validation formula Strang splitting: Dirichlet boundary order reduction and correction ut=uxx+u,u(0,t)=u(1,t)=1,w=u−1 Araw(w)=Lhw, Braw(w)=w+1;Acorr(w)=Lhw+1, Bcorr(w)=w Evolve actual one-dimensional nonperiodic fields and compare unmodified and boundary-corrected Strang splitting against the same spatial discretization. Exact and reference solutions First qualify an independent sparse affine exponential action against separately written sine sums. Then separate temporal error against the same finite-difference system, spatial error against the analytic continuum field, and observed order in the fixed regime. Semi-analytic referenceReference for the same problem Strang splitting: Dirichlet boundary order reduction and correction u_t=u_{xx}+u,\quad u(0,t)=u(1,t)=1,\quad w=u-1;\quad A_{\rm raw}(w)=L_hw,\ B_{\rm raw}(w)=w+1;\quad A_{\rm corr}(w)=L_hw+1,\ B_{\rm corr}(w)=w Solve u_t = u_xx + u on [0, 1] with both boundary values equal to 1, an analytic steady state plus a 0.1 sine perturbation, and T = 0.1. Use 31, 63 and 127 interior nodes with 8, 16, 32 and 64 steps, plus four Lie controls: 28 runs. This is an authored linear specialization, not a reproduction of the original nonlinear tables. It makes no general claim for nonautonomous boundaries or universal order loss. The final reaction-trace mismatch of Lie splitting is disclosed separately.
